{{Recipe}}

'''Cornish fairings''' are traditional Cornish spiced biscuits with a real kick.

==Ingredients==
*110 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] or 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*60 g (¼ cup or 2 oz) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]] 
*60 g (¼ cup or 2 oz) [[Cookbook:Caster sugar|caster sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (levelled, not heaped) [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*2 tsp [[Cookbook:Golden Syrup|golden syrup]]
*1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Mixed Spice|mixed spice]]
*1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

==Equipment==
*1 [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Mixing bowl|mixing bowl]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Wooden Spoon|wooden spoon]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cookie Sheet|baking tray]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Rolling Pin|rolling pin]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cooling rack|cooling rack]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|180°C (350°F or Gas Mark 4)]].
#[[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] the flour into a mixing bowl, then rub in the butter.
#Sift in the caster sugar, baking powder, and spices, then mix well.
#Add the syrup to the mixture, then stir in until it becomes a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
#Roll the dough out into little balls about the size of [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]].
#Place the balls on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]], then [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 15 minutes.
#Allow the fairings to cool for a few minutes on the cooling rack before serving.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F or Gas Mark 4).
Sift the flour into a mixing bowl, then rub in the butter.
Sift in the caster sugar, baking powder, and spices, then mix well.
Add the syrup to the mixture, then stir in until it becomes a dough.
Roll the dough out into little balls about the size of walnuts.
Place the balls on a baking tray, then bake for 15 minutes.
Allow the fairings to cool for a few minutes on the cooling rack before serving.
